verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (headline, list, CTA, footer). But the 'Find Solstice' line is wedged between bullets, the bullets are reordered and stepped in like a staircase, the big top area is empty, and the logo is shrunk to a tiny footer pill. B puts the CTA and the legal line above the headline, blows the logo pill up into the biggest element at bottom right, and has the same jumbled, staircased list. Its hierarchy is inverted and it leaves large dead space.

A has a clear split with the product on the left and headline, list and CTA on the right. The CTA sits correctly under the copy. Flaws: the 'Find Solstice' copy is inserted into the bullet list, the bullets are out of order and drift rightward, the logo is reduced to a tiny footer pill, and the product is small. B leads with the CTA at top right, places legal text near the top, uses an oversized logo pill as the dominant bottom element, and leaves a cramped, staircased list beside a big empty lower-left area.

B has a strong full-width headline and a reasonable CTA-left, product-right pairing. But the list is centered and staircased while the 'Find Solstice' line is left-aligned, so the edges are ragged. The body copy also sits inside the list, the bullet order is scrambled, and the logo shrinks to a small footer pill. A has an inverted order: CTA and legal text sit above the headline, and an oversized logo pill dominates the bottom right. It has the same broken list and leaves a large empty lower-left area.
